caption:
Mr Turtle spends his whole shift on the headset, and by home time his neck and shoulders feel like rocks.

Sitting in one position for hours gives your neck and shoulder muscles little chance to rest, so tension can build up. Short movement breaks between calls and taking some calls standing may help. Remedial massage can be a helpful sidekick, easing tight muscles as part of your recovery.

Hybi's tip: keep the screen at eye level, roll your shoulders 10 times between calls, and stand up briefly every 30 minutes.

Arm or hand tingling, or frequent headaches, are worth getting checked. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD remedial massage therapists can help. Book online via the link in bio
